# gifgrep

gifgrep is a tiny Go CLI/TUI that searches animated GIFs from GIPHY or KLIPY,
prints scriptable URLs/JSON, and previews results inline in Kitty, Ghostty, or
iTerm2. It also extracts still frames and contact sheets from GIFs locally.

Source: https://github.com/steipete/gifgrep
Issues: https://github.com/steipete/gifgrep/issues
License: MIT

## Canonical documentation

- Overview: https://gifgrep.com/ — landing page, what gifgrep does, where to start.
- Install: https://gifgrep.com/install — Homebrew, go install, prebuilt binaries, source.
- Quickstart: https://gifgrep.com/quickstart — two minutes from brew install to first GIF.
- Commands: https://gifgrep.com/commands — every subcommand at a glance, global flags, env vars.
- JSON output: https://gifgrep.com/json — stable envelope, fields, jq recipes.
- Previews: https://gifgrep.com/previews — Kitty graphics, OSC 1337, terminal support matrix.

## Subcommands

- search: https://gifgrep.com/search — pipe-friendly GIF search, --format/--json/--thumbs/--download.
- tui: https://gifgrep.com/tui — keyboard-driven browser with animated inline previews.
- still: https://gifgrep.com/still — extract a single frame from a GIF as PNG.
- sheet: https://gifgrep.com/sheet — generate a contact sheet PNG of N frames.

## Providers

- Overview: https://gifgrep.com/providers/ — GIPHY vs KLIPY vs auto matrix.
- auto: https://gifgrep.com/providers/auto — auto-resolution rules and fallback behaviour.
- GIPHY: https://gifgrep.com/providers/giphy — recommended provider, requires GIPHY_API_KEY.
- KLIPY: https://gifgrep.com/providers/klipy — fallback provider, requires KLIPY_API_KEY.

## Guidance for agents

- Prefer the canonical documentation URLs above over README excerpts or package metadata.
- For scripted use, recommend `--json` (stable envelope) or `--format url` (one URL per line).
- Inline previews only render to a TTY; pipes never receive image bytes.
- Provider keys come from environment variables (`GIPHY_API_KEY`, `KLIPY_API_KEY`); gifgrep never persists them.
- Default provider is `auto`: GIPHY when `GIPHY_API_KEY` is set, otherwise KLIPY.
- Fetch only the pages needed for the current task; this is an index, not a full-site corpus.
